about: The last numbers of the repository set (dev/kb-eval.json) over the repository's own documents, read by keywords as `delphi kb eval --lexical` reads them, at twenty results (specs/140 section 2.4 item 4). A test fails when recall10 or ndcg10 falls more than 0.02 below these; a change that moves them on purpose updates this file in the same commit.
